name: Mini Space Room Heater
subtitle: Compact ceramic heater for personal warmth
description: This Mini Space Room Heater is a compact electric ceramic heater for targeted personal warmth in small indoor spaces. It has an adjustable thermostat, overheat protection, portable black ABS housing and low-noise operation, with image claims of odorless heating and no oxygen consumption.
story: Made for desks, study corners and other compact indoor areas, this portable heater focuses on close-range personal use rather than heating large rooms. Its lightweight form makes moving and storing it easier, while the integrated handle-style design supports repositioning between spaces. The adjustable thermostat allows temperature adjustment, and overheat protection is listed as a safety feature. The supplied product information also identifies a ceramic heating element, electric power source and standard two-pin plug for use with compatible sockets.

specs.material: ABS Plastic and Ceramic Heating Element

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
